diabolo_axis_from_image — DRIVE diabolo op

• Data kinds: rgb × table × table → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.diabolo_axis_from_image(img, cam: 'dict', params: 'dict', *, refine: 'bool' = True, iters: 'int' = 15) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import diabolo; diabolo.diabolo_axis_from_image(img, cam: 'dict', params: 'dict', *, refine: 'bool' = True, iters: 'int' = 15) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("diabolo_axis_from_image"))

Usage

From 1 frame, finds the center of the near cup's rim center_rim and the axis axis (pointing toward the camera). Diabolo center center = center_rim − (L/2) axis. No learning.

Initial values (weak perspective): semi-major axis of the rim ellipse → depth, minor / major = cos θ, offset of the bottom plate centre = (L/2 − z_h) sin θ, θ = atan2(sin, cos) (avoids the acos floor), direction of the offset = direction of the axis in the image. Refinement: the polygon moments (area, centroid, second order) of the exact perspective projections of the rim circle (radius R, centre C) and the bottom plate (radius r_h, centre C − (L/2 − z_h) a) are matched to the mask moments by Gauss–Newton (5 degrees of freedom, 8 residuals). If the residual residual_px exceeds 0.15 px, ok = False (bottom plate hidden by the wall etc.; 2.8 px at 45° from the line of sight, ≤ 0.02 px up to 38°).

Returns {"center", "center_rim", "axis", "axis_init", "tilt_init_deg", "a_px", "b_px", "residual_px", "ok", "seg"}. Raises ValueError: image shape, inside of the cup or bottom plate not visible (cannot estimate).
